seo.title: DMK Airport Guide: Don Mueang Terminals & Transport | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Bangkok's dedicated low-cost carrier hub: terminals, SRT Red Line, and tips
seo.meta_description: Complete passenger guide for Don Mueang Airport (DMK) in Bangkok. Includes SRT Red Line train tips, AirAsia flights, and terminal advice.

faqs.answer: Yes, Terminals 1 and 2 are connected by an enclosed indoor corridor on Level 1 and Level 3. Walking between check-in areas takes less than 5 minutes.
faqs.question: Can I walk between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 at Don Mueang?

faqs.answer: Follow signs to the SRT Red Line station via the covered skybridge on Level 2. Trains reach Krung Thep Aphiwat Central Station in 20 minutes for 33 THB.
faqs.question: How do I take the train from Don Mueang Airport to central Bangkok?

steps.body: International arrivals land at Terminal 1; all domestic flights land at Terminal 2. Both terminals are connected by a short indoor walkway.
steps.title: 1. Terminal Assignment

steps.body: Immigration counters are on the 2nd Floor of Terminal 1. After customs clearance, exit to the public arrival concourse.
steps.title: 2. Passport Control & Baggage

steps.body: Take the elevated skybridge to Don Mueang SRT Red Line Station, board the A1/A2 express buses outside Gate 6, or queue for metered taxis.
steps.title: 3. Transport Options

arrival.summary: Arrival corridors, baggage claim, and city transfer options at Don Mueang.

notices.body: During weekday rush hours (07:00–09:30 and 16:30–19:30), highway congestion along Don Mueang Tollway can add 30 to 45 minutes to taxi rides.
notices.title: Allow Extra Time for Tollway Traffic

steps.body: Terminal 1 Level 3 handles all international check-in, immigration, and boarding gates 1–26.
steps.title: 1. International Departures (Terminal 1)

steps.body: Terminal 2 Level 3 handles all domestic flights (AirAsia, Nok Air, Lion Air). Automated self-check-in kiosks and bag-drop machines are widely available.

orientation.intro: Don Mueang International Airport (DMK) is Asia's oldest operating commercial airport, located 24 km north of central Bangkok.
orientation.summary: Serving as Bangkok's primary hub for low-cost airlines, including Thai AirAsia, Nok Air, and Thai Lion Air, operating across two adjacent terminals.

default_transport.name: SRT Dark Red Line / A1 Airport Bus
